hero.h1: Home Remodeling and Finish Carpentry in Lochbuie, CO
hero.subheadline: Luis and the LCR crew handle crown and wall molding, deck rebuilds, porches and interior remodeling, with 20 years of experience and fair, clear bids.

image.alt: Home remodeling by LCR Home Solutions of Lochbuie: dining room with white picture-frame wall molding, crown trim and a black iron chandelier

intro.h2: Detail Work That Changes a Whole Room
paragraphs: LCR Home Solutions is a home remodeling company in Lochbuie, Colorado, and its finish carpentry is what customers talk about first. Jennifer O. had a vision for her dining room, and Luis trimmed it out in crown and wall molding from floor to ceiling.

Outside, the crew rebuilds weathered decks and replaces front porches. Tommy W. had his entire porch replaced in less than a week. Reviewers keep coming back to the same points: fair bids, clear and constant communication, and a crew that is pleasant to have around the house. Luis is the name in every captured review, and the number on the Instagram page is his.

items.name: Crown molding and wall molding
items.blurb: Picture-frame wall molding, crown and trim that turn a plain room into a finished one. Luis lays out the panels to suit the windows, ceiling height and furniture, and reviewers praise his eye for design and attention to detail.

image.alt: Formal dining room with white wall molding panels, tall drapes, a long wood table and an iron chandelier

items.name: Deck rebuilds and restoration
items.blurb: Badly weathered decks rebuilt from the frame up, including raised decks with stairs and white railings over a patio. The crew replaces failing posts, beams and joists before the new decking and rails go on.

image.alt: Raised wood deck with white railings and stairs, lattice screening below and new wood posts

items.name: Front porch replacement
items.blurb: Full front porch replacements with new framing, decking, steps and trim. One homeowner had the entire porch replaced in less than a week and called the work honest and high quality. Gray composite-look decking gives an older brick house a clean entry.

image.alt: New gray front porch with steps and white columns on a red brick house

items.name: Interior remodeling, kitchens and baths
items.blurb: Interior and exterior remodeling, as printed on the crew's shirts, including kitchen, bathroom and flooring work listed on their social profile. Ask Luis about your project when you call, and he can tell you what fits the schedule and how the bid would be built.

items.title: An eye for design
items.text: Jennifer O. says Luis has an exceptional eye for design, meticulous attention to detail and a very high level of skill. Her dining room molding is in the photos above.

items.title: Fair bids
items.text: Fair bids is one of the most mentioned topics in their Google reviews, and Jennifer O. wrote that Luis delivers outstanding quality at a fair price.

items.title: Fast, without cutting corners
items.text: Tommy W. had his whole front porch replaced in less than a week. Reviewers say the crew is fast and efficient while still doing a quality job.

items.title: You always know where things stand
items.text: Reviewers say Luis communicates clearly and consistently and was in constant communication about the project. Sandra H. called him reliable and very pleasant to work with.

about.text: LCR Home Solutions LLC is based on Jewel Street in Lochbuie, Colorado. Luis is the name on every captured review and the person who answers the phone, and his social profile lists 20 years of experience. The work ranges from finish carpentry inside, like crown and wall molding, to decks, porches and other exterior repairs. Customers describe him as hardworking, honest and easy to talk to, and several say they will be hiring him again for their next project around the house.

process.h2: From First Call to Finished Room

steps.title: Call Luis
steps.text: Call (720) 350-1984 Monday to Thursday 7 AM to 7 PM, or Friday until 5 PM, and describe the room or structure.

steps.title: Look and bid
steps.text: Luis looks at the space, talks through your ideas and gives you a bid. Reviewers describe the bids as fair.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The crew does the framing, trim or decking with regular updates, so you know what is happening each day.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: Luis walks the finished work with you so you can check every joint, rail and board before the crew packs up.

items.name: Jennifer O.
items.text: This review is for crown molding and wall molding: I truly cannot emphasize enough how Luis brought my dream dining room to life. I had a vision, and he executed it seamlessly. He has an exceptional eye for design, meticulous attention to detail, and a very high level of skill. He is hardworking, communicates clearly and consistently, and delivers outstanding quality at a fair price. We will absolutely be hiring him again for future projects—we couldn’t be happier with the result.

items.name: Tommy W.
items.text: LCR Home Solutions provided efficient and high quality work. They replaced my entire front porch in less than a week. Honest and high quality work!

items.name: Sandra H.
items.text: They did an amazing job on are deck I would recommend him to anyone . Luis did a great job on our badly weathered deck. He was reliable and very pleasant to work with. I highly recommend LCR Home solution

service_area.text: LCR Home Solutions is based at 579 Jewel St in Lochbuie, Colorado, and Luis describes his coverage as the city and surrounding areas. The projects shared on Google include an older brick bungalow, a raised backyard deck and a two-story home with a formal dining room. If you are near Lochbuie and not sure whether you are in range, call Luis and ask before you plan the project.

items.q: What kind of work does LCR Home Solutions do?
items.a: Finish carpentry such as crown molding and wall molding, deck rebuilds and restoration, front porch replacement, and interior and exterior remodeling. Their social profile also lists kitchen, bathroom and flooring work. For anything else, describe it to Luis on the phone and he will be straight with you about whether it suits his crew.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job, and Luis will give you a timeline with your bid. As one example, a homeowner in the reviews had an entire front porch replaced in less than a week. Molding in a single room is usually a shorter job than a deck rebuild.

items.q: How do I get a bid?
items.a: Call Luis at (720) 350-1984 or email lcrhomesolutionsllc@gmail.com. He will look at the space, talk through what you want and give you a bid. Fair bids is one of the topics customers mention most in their Google reviews, along with clear communication.

Monday to Thursday from 7 AM to 7 PM and Friday from 7 AM to 5 PM. The office is closed on Saturday and Sunday. If you call while Luis is on a job site, leave a message with your name, address and project, and he will get back to you.

LCR Home Solutions LLC is at 579 Jewel St, Lochbuie, CO 80603, and serves Lochbuie and the surrounding areas. Call ahead with your address so Luis can confirm the drive and fit your project into the schedule before he comes out to look at it.

final_cta.text: Call Luis to talk through your molding, deck, porch or remodeling project in Lochbuie.
